question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only three persons have exams between R and V. Only two persons have exams between Q and P. V's exam is on Saturday. Q's exam is immediately before R. Only U's exam is between P and V. T's exam is not held on Wednesday. Q's exam is on Monday. On which day is S's exam held?
